mythology: Sati's eyes (or left hand holding weapon) fell here; also known as Karavira Kshetra where Mahalakshmi chose to dwell eternally after departing Vaikuntha.
festivals: Kiranotsav (Sun Ray Festival in January and November)
pilgrimage_significance: One of the four major Shakti peethas of Maharashtra and a paramount Vaishnava-Shakta tirth; visiting Tirupati Balaji is traditionally completed by worshipping Ambabai here.
historical_notes: Mentioned in Padma Purana and Karavira Mahatmya; served as the spiritual stronghold for the Deccan empires and Maratha Swarajya.
